summary: Modal, non-modal or alert dialog on the native dialog element, with title, body and footer slots; opened by the open attribute or show().

usage.text: Nothing opens it for you: set open or call show(). hide(returnValue?) closes it and returnValue reads the value back. Footer buttons need their own click handlers to close it.
type is modal (default, showModal()), non-modal (show(), page stays usable) or alert: role alertdialog, described by its body, and Escape does not close it.
The close button and Escape fire a cancelable request-close with detail.source "close-button" or "keyboard"; preventDefault() keeps it open. hide() and removing open skip it.
The header close button shows unless no-close-button is set; with no title and no-close-button the header is hidden. Only set it when a footer action closes the dialog.

a11y.text: Content in the title slot names the dialog. Without it the dialog is named "Dialog"; an aria-label on the host is not used, so always fill the title slot.
On close, focus returns to the element focused when it opened, even inside another component's shadow root. A body that overflows becomes a tab stop so keyboard users can scroll it.
